recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-17542 unless a future Extension Pack review identifies a specific non-camelCase OO extension definition outside the checked examples.
issue_request: FHIR-17542 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request for STU3 asking to update all OO extension names to camelCase for consistency. The Jira comment gave Observation examples to change from focus-code, time-offset, sequel-to, gateway-device, and specimen-code to focusCode, timeOffset, sequelTo, gatewayDevice, and specimenCode.
initial_application: Git commit 7746262ec15c5fb2f931148ad148df6875aebaeb, titled "GF#17542 update all OO extensions to camelCase", pre-applied the request before final Jira publication. It changed Observation and related OO extension source references, including links and definitions for the cited names.
additional_context: Commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 later removed the cited Observation extension StructureDefinition files from the R5 core source as extensions moved out of core. Current core retains camelCase OID entries for the cited Observation extension URLs, and the FHIR Extension Pack now contains the current definitions with camelCase id, url, and fixedUri values. The only active current-source hit for the old string focus-code is ResearchStudy-focus-code, a search parameter code rather than an OO extension.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because current in-scope core references and the Extension Pack source of truth already satisfy the requested camelCase rename, and exact searches did not find active current source defining or linking the cited Observation extensions under the old hyphenated names.
